Upcoming Mercedes-AMG CLE 63 S With V8 Gets Rid of the Camouflage and Is Unmasked in Fantasy Land
9 photos
Photo: avarvarii / Instagram
Back in late 2023, Mercedes-Benz decided to showcase to the world the new Mercedes-Benz CLE grand tourer class with a C236 coupe and the A236 cabriolet body styles – they consolidated the former C-Class and E-Class sports cars into a single series aimed at combating the BMW 4 Series.
The CLE Coupe was introduced to replace both the C-Class Coupe and E-Class Coupe as part of Mercedes' focus on reimagining the model range – but at least they didn’t kill all of them as Audi did with the A5 series, which is now a fastback sedan and a station wagon instead of a coupe, cabriolet, and fastback.
Still a product of its times, the new Mercedes-Benz CLE grand tourer gained a wide array of powertrains: mild hybrid diesel on the CLE 220d, a mild hybrid turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-four, a mild hybrid turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-six, plus a CLE 300e plug-in hybrid setup. The AMG version was initially launched as the Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 with the mild-hybrid AMG-enhanced M256 3.0-liter inline six-cylinder engine packing an exhaust gas turbocharger and electric auxiliary compressor.
It also had the AMG Performance 4Matic+ fully variable all-wheel drive and active rear-axle steering, plus the distinctive AMG styling, but it doesn’t actually pack a massive punch: 443 hp and up to 433 lb-ft or 587 Nm with overboost for ten seconds. Of course, soon enough there were ample rumors about the CLE 63 going against the inline-four C-Class PHEV setup with a return to V8 form.
The news outlets exploded this year as tension began building up for the mighty AMG – and Mercedes released part of it in early September 2026 when it unleashed the hard-to-pronounce Mercedes-AMG CLE 646 Spezialanfertigung (Special Edition) as the latest entry into the bespoke Mythos series, with the 4.0‑liter V8 biturbo AMG engine rocking 637 hp under the hood and sending them only to the rear wheels.
Alas, the new model is actually something that only collectors and one-percenter enthusiasts can get due to the rumored $800k price and the ultra-exclusive production run of just 30 units. As such, once the hype went down, fans were back to square one, dreaming and hoping that a Mercedes-AMG CLE 63 or 63 S is coming to them without the E Performance moniker but instead with a V8.
Well, the spy photographers are now busy catching the Mercedes-AMG Black Series while out testing, yet a member of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators can’t stop dwelling across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI because they’re thinking that a Mercedes-AMG CLE 63 is also around the corner.
More precisely, Avarvarii Automotive Artworks (also known as ' avarvarii ' on social media) has taken a thorough, in-depth CGI look at AMG's upcoming plans and came up with this – the unmasked CLE 63. So, what do you think – yay or nay? View this post on Instagram A post shared by Avarvarii Automotive Artworks (@avarvarii)
